entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The French Defence Central Health Service is responsible for medical and sanitary support to the French Armed Forces and of all institutions placed under the authority of the French Ministry of Armed Forces. It is a joint service, and its central administration is under the direct control of the Chief of the defence staff.
